templates.title: Linked representations
templates.summary: Follow stable identifiers across a thresholded network, spectra and candidate evidence.
templates.learning_goal: Relate one controlled threshold change across linked representations without turning similarity into identification.

templates.title: Controlled parameter comparison
templates.summary: Compare one baseline with one variation while holding the stated control fixed.
templates.learning_goal: Attribute a numerical change to one varied parameter within the limits of a controlled synthetic comparison.

templates.title: Evidence and claim
templates.summary: Judge which bounded claim is supported by a supplied source excerpt.
templates.learning_goal: Distinguish a source-backed claim from stronger conclusions that the evidence does not establish.

templates.title: Diagnose a flawed analysis
templates.summary: Locate a consequential flaw in a captured analysis and compare supplied repair results.
templates.learning_goal: Connect a diagnosed analytical flaw to its effect on a result and to a check that can detect it.

templates.title: Test conclusion robustness
templates.summary: Compare captured results under supplied assumptions and check where a bounded conclusion survives.
templates.learning_goal: State which assumptions a conclusion depends on and where the conclusion changes.
